reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki, and I replied to Anselm in the DM to say so.

- **The draft:** it's addressed to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat figure, says Marcus Lindqvist supplied it and that Anselm approved sharing it, and asks Hollis to keep it within the deal team. It has not been sent; someone needs to send it.
- **Why no further approval was needed:** Anselm is the CFO, so he can approve sharing a finance figure with Hollis. The mail goes to a pemberline.com address, so Ruth Calloway's sign-off for outside mail doesn't apply.
- **Not checked against a document:** there are no Thornbury files in the share, and GBrain had nothing on Thornbury either, though its search was running in keyword-only mode. The $2,101 figure comes only from Anselm's message, and I told him that.
